name: Kutsujoku to Chijoku ni Otosareta Mesu Buta Dorei no Haha
original_name: 屈辱と恥辱に堕とされた 牝豚奴隷の母
source:
It was just before summer. Misaki's life was falling apart.
She had met one of Kaori's male classmates during a morning jog.
Making love, forced to make love, behind her daughter's back and beside her sleeping husband.
She was powerless, craven, like a sow in lust, and though she hated it she loved it.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE085570.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
那时正值初夏，春日野美咲的生活正逐渐崩塌。
晨跑时，她遇见了女儿香织的一名男同学。
做爱，被迫做爱；瞒着女儿，甚至就在熟睡的丈夫身旁。
她无力又怯懦，像一头发情的母猪。她明明厌恶这一切，却又沉醉其中。

[引自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE085570.html]DLsite英文站[/url]]
